general_skills.title: Read the experimental objective
general_skills.principle: Identify the target property or transformation and any required focus or measurement steps. Plan a short sequence of subgoals from the stated objective.
general_skills.when_to_apply: At task start and when reconsidering progress.

general_skills.title: Ground objects in observations
general_skills.principle: Use observed object names and locations. Inspect relevant rooms or containers when necessary rather than assuming locations from another episode.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When locating materials, instruments or a destination.

general_skills.title: Check prerequisites
general_skills.principle: Before changing an object's state, check the relevant container, device, connection and material prerequisites using available observations.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Before a manipulation or when an action fails.

general_skills.title: Observe after an intervention
general_skills.principle: Use the simulator's response to determine whether an action changed the intended state. Measure or inspect relevant properties when the task requires evidence.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After heating, cooling, mixing, connecting or other interventions.

general_skills.title: Correct failed actions
general_skills.principle: Read the failure response, identify the unmet prerequisite or ambiguous object reference, and change the next action accordingly instead of repeating the same failed command.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the simulator rejects an action or progress stalls.

general_skills.title: Track completion conditions
general_skills.principle: Track which requested conditions have actually been established. Perform focus or measurement actions when required by the task and use simulator feedback to determine completion.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Throughout the experiment and before declaring completion.
